newsitem.title: GERMANY: German steel production rises in first half 1997.
newsitem.headline: German steel production rises in first half 1997.

text.p: German steel production rose in the first half of 1997, with output of crude steel up 12.6 percent from a year earlier at 22.01 million tonnes, the government statistics office said on Friday.
Production of crude iron was up 11.3 percent in the first six months of 1997 at 15.07 milion tonnes.
Data for June only showed crude iron production up 12.8 percent at 2.56 million tonnes and crude steel production up 15.8 percent to 3.81 million tonnes.
